summary_markdown: Someone investigated an issue related to MAC addresses and found it was caused by a caching overlap. The problem only occurred if the system detected MAC addresses containing zeros within a five-minute window, specifically when those MAC addresses shared the same initial sequence up to the first zero. Without the cache mechanism, the functionality worked correctly.
decisions: The root cause of the issue (MAC address conflict) was identified as a caching overlap.
action_items: Someone will fix the reported issue.
